brief: What did Nusantara Olefins spend on the Cilegon expansion?

sections.title: Nusantara Olefins Cilegon Expansion: Company Disclosures
questions: Has Nusantara Olefins disclosed the capital expenditure or investment amount for the Cilegon cracker expansion?
Are there any figures, estimates, or statements regarding the cost of the expansion in company press releases or industry bulletins?
sections.tool_rationale: Only company press releases or industry bulletins may contain explicit statements or figures regarding project spending; the plant register does not include financial data.
sections.unanswerable_if: No document in the corpus contains a statement or figure for the Cilegon expansion's capital expenditure or investment amount.

excluded.topic: Detailed project cost breakdown or future spending plans for Cilegon expansion
excluded.reason: The corpus only contains company press releases and industry bulletins, which may state a total figure but do not provide detailed breakdowns or forward-looking spending plans.

excluded.topic: Any financial data from Nusantara Olefins' official filings or annual reports
excluded.reason: The dataset is part_a, which does not include company financial filings or annual reports; only press releases and industry bulletins are available.
